relationships.evidence_quote: Chronic nicotine activated dopaminergic projections from the VTA to pyramidal neurones in the ACC

relationships.subject: VTA dopaminergic projections to ACC
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic inhibition of VTA dopaminergic terminals in the ACC alleviated chronic nicotine-induced allodynia in mice

relationships.subject: Drd2

key_findings: Chronic nicotine activates VTA dopaminergic input to ACC pyramidal neurons.
